lead: Nandamuri Harikrishna was an Indian politician, born on 2 September 1956 in Nemmikuru.
He died on 29 August 2018 in Narketpalle at the age of 61.
He has 13 credited works on public record and has held the office of member of Rajya Sabha.
This profile collects the Nandamuri facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Nandamuri Harikrishna — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Nandamuri Harikrishna was born on 2 September 1956 in Nemmikuru, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, N. T. Rama Rao and his mother, Basava Tarakam. He is a sibling of Nandamuri Balakrishna and Daggubati Purandeswari.
He is recorded as speaking Telugu.

sections.heading: Nandamuri Harikrishna — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician and actor as his occupations.
He has held the following offices: member of Rajya Sabha (2008–present). He is affiliated with Telugu Desam Party.
